results.correct_value: A hard-sided bear canister is required at every Olympic wilderness camp, including the Elwha; bear wires are not an approved method
results.evidence: The park's wilderness food-storage page says animal-resistant food containers are required in all wilderness areas of the park and lists only vehicles, park food lockers and approved canisters as methods. The park's Elwha River Trail page lists the food storage method as bear canisters, and a trail-association notice says hanging food is no longer compliant. The bivy entries were right; what_to_bring and access.rules were outdated.
